title: Migrate validate plugin to contract v2
goal: Adopt the ADR-054/ADR-055 v2 stage contract in plugins/agent/validate: v2 result file shape with result_contract:2, disposition on every exit path, rc ∈ {0,1}, name-matched inputs via ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS, and result_contract:2 in the manifest — tests written first, red before green.

steps.description: Write failing v2-contract tests (SPEC-14..18) before any implementation change, and update SPEC-9/11/12 fixtures to export ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS and ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR so existing tests resolve paths the new way. SPEC-14: every exit path emits result_contract:2 + verdict + disposition + reason (assert on all 5 exit paths: no-state-file, missing-input, dry-run, healthy-probe, missing-hc-plugin). SPEC-15: a grep over plugin.sh finds zero occurrences of path construction from $artifacts_dir (no-path-construction assertion). SPEC-16: each valid_verdict (healthy, error) is driven by at least one test case that checks that exact value. SPEC-17: fail-closed rc propagation preserved — failed probe still returns non-zero rc under v2. SPEC-18: plugin reads deploy_result path from ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS, not from a derived $artifacts_dir path. Confirm each new spec FAILS before any implementation change.

Add `result_contract: 2` to the `provides:` block in manifest.yaml. This is the only manifest change needed: valid_verdicts, role, events, primary: true output, and name-matched inputs (id+required only, no path/from) are already correct.

Rewrite plugin.sh to v2 contract: (1) Add helper `_validate_write_result <artifact_dir> <verdict> <disposition> <reason>` that writes `{result_contract:2, verdict, disposition, reason, data:{}}` via atomic_write, mirroring the design plugin pattern. (2) In `_validate_agent_run_inner`: resolve deploy_result input path via `jq -r '.inputs.deploy_result // empty' "$ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS"` instead of constructing `$artifacts_dir/deploy-result.json`; resolve validate_result output path from `${ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR}/validate-result.json` instead of `$artifacts_dir/validate-result.json`; replace all v1 `printf/jq` result writes with `_validate_write_result` calls using disposition words: missing-input → `broken`, dry-run → `complete`, healthy-probe → `complete`, failed-probe → `complete`, missing-hc-plugin → `broken`. (3) In `validate_agent_run`: replace `return 2` (no-state-file path) with `return 1` and write a v2 result via `_validate_write_result`. (4) Change every remaining `return 2` to `return 1`. (5) Preserve the fail-closed rc-propagation for probe failures (`return "$hc_rc"` stays as-is since hc_rc comes from health_check_run and is already 1 after the rc ∈ {0,1} constraint). The cleanup comment at line 118 is unchanged — no live resources means hook body correctly absent.

Run `npm test` (full suite) to confirm all specs including SPEC-14..18 go green, and run `bash scripts/check-coverage.sh` to verify the 29% coverage floor is not broken. Also verify the no-path-construction grep assertion passes (SPEC-15 doubles as the acceptance criterion 'The plugin constructs no artifact paths in code').

notes: Router budgets (#1816): validate makes no LLM calls ('No LLM calls (no route_to_model)' in manifest description). The router: section and max_turns/timeout_s fields are inapplicable; plan omits them. --- cleanup hook: manifest already declares only `run`; validate holds no live resources, so the hook is correctly absent per issue text 'if it has nothing to free, the hook is absent and that is recorded, not implied'. No manifest change needed. --- primary: true output: already declared on validate_result in the manifest (line 48) — the acceptance checkbox is pre-satisfied; plan notes this and moves on. --- Template wiring: validate already appears in config/templates/deployed.yaml flow; no template file change needed. --- ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS fixture: tests write a minimal JSON index (`{"inputs":{"deploy_result":"<path>"}}`) to a temp file and export ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS pointing to it. ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR is exported to the test run's artifacts dir. --- Disposition mappings: missing required input (no ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS or path empty, or file absent) → `broken`; dry-run → `complete`; healthy probe → `complete`; failed probe → `complete` (probe ran to a verdict, engine's response table decides retry); missing hc-plugin binary → `broken` (installation fault, engine contract violated). These map to the vocabulary in core/pipeline/disposition.sh. --- fail-closed preservation: `return "$hc_rc"` for probe failures is kept as-is; since health_check_run is under our mock in tests we control hc_rc=1 which satisfies rc ∈ {0,1}. The issue notes (#757) that 'a failed probe must not return success' — the propagation stays verbatim. --- The prior plan's step-2 noted manifest already correct except result_contract; this is confirmed by reading manifest.yaml line 24–60: no result_contract field present in provides: block.
